senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. סָעַר II)to be rough, denom. שֵׂעָר; to shudder, fear.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 318:15">Sifré Deut. 318</cite> (expl. <he>שערום</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:17">Deut. XXXII, 17</cite>) <he>שלא עמדה שערת וכ׳</he> your fathers’ hair did not stand on end before them (v. <cite ref="U01680"><he>שָׁעַר</he> II</cite>); Yalk. ib. 545.

senses.gloss: (denom. of שֵׂעָר) to grow hair, be hairy.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 44a">Ḥull. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>עד מקום שיַשְׂעִיר</he> Ms. M. a Rashi (ed. <he>כדי</he>, corr. acc.) to the place (of the stomach) where it becomes covered with hair.
<cite ref="Chullin 44a:9">Ib.</cite> (Chald. diction) <he>תורא דמַשְׂעִיר טפי</he> an ox, which is more hairy (on the stomach).
<cite ref="Niddah 25b:30">Nidd. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שישעיר</he> until the embryo has hair.
